h2.rule: per potential: the sign test over seeds (per-seed median rho > 0; a seed without a defined rho counts as 0) rejects after Holm over potential x scenario with data, and the median of the per-seed medians is positive, in every scenario with data (holds) or in some (partial)

method.aggregate: median of the per-seed medians with a 95% percentile bootstrap over seeds (10,000 resamples, seed 0)
method.deduplication: each distinct (configuration without label, seed) counts once (manifest config without label, runID and maxWall), the first in registry group order
method.holm_families: within each family, over potential x scenario with data

leadlag.aggregate: median over runs with a 95% percentile bootstrap CI (descriptive)
leadlag.statistic: Pearson of -dPhi(t) with dRemovals(t+k) over overlapping post-warmup minutes

method.per_run_statistic: Spearman of -(Phi(t) - Phi(t-w)) with y(t), undefined if a series is constant or there are fewer windows than min_windows_per_run
method.sign_test: exact one-sided binomial over seeds, H1: P(per-seed median > 0) > 1/2; non-positive medians count against; floor 0.5^n_seeds
method.unit: the workload seed: per (potential, scenario, seed) the median rho over the seed's runs with a defined rho, 0 when none
method.why_raw: the potentials as defined (registry exp2.params.potentials); the normalized forms divide by ln(ready nodes) or the ready fleet price, which shrink whenever an empty node is removed, so they rise mechanically at removals
